minimalsanitized.rationale: Grants voting power instantly upon deposit with no time delay or holding period. This enables flash loan attacks where an attacker can borrow massive funds, deposit, vote, execute, and repay within a single transaction.

Updates total voting power immediately. Part of the same deposit mechanism as CA1. Prerequisite because it enables the percentage calculation to include attacker's funds, but the primary flaw is instant voting power grant (CA1).
Tracks deposited balance. Prerequisite because it enables the deposit flow, but the vulnerability is the instant voting power, not the balance tracking.

Calculates vote percentage using current values. The calculation itself is correct; the vulnerability is that upstream deposit grants instant voting power (CA1). Prerequisite because it uses manipulated inputs but isn't inherently flawed.
Threshold check with no timelock or minimum holding period. Once 66% is reached (trivially with flash loan), proposal can execute immediately. No time delay for community review.

Executes the approved proposal. The call itself is correctly implemented; the flaw is in how authorization was obtained (instant voting power). Prerequisite because it realizes the attack impact but isn't the causal origin.
Prevents double execution. Correctly implemented.
Marks proposal as executed before external call. Follows CEI pattern for reentrancy prevention.
Checks external call success. Correctly implemented.
Event emission for logging.
Prevents double voting. Correctly implemented.
Prevents voting on executed proposals. Correctly implemented.
Adds voter's power to proposal. Prerequisite because it accumulates votes, but the issue is instant power granting, not the vote counting mechanism.
Marks voter as having voted. Correctly implemented.
Increments proposal counter. Correctly implemented.
Initializes proposal struct. Correctly implemented.
Auto-votes with proposer's voting power. Prerequisite because combined with instant voting power, this immediately gives attacker a head start toward 66%.
Marks proposer as having voted. Correctly implemented.
